{"metadata":{"description":"Login gate for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web surface: password or shared-token sign-in, optional TOTP two-factor, session cookies, rate limiting, self-service password change and a user-management CLI. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 网页版登录门插件：账号密码或共享令牌登录、可选 TOTP 两步验证、会话 cookie、登录限速、自助改密，附用户管","id":"gh:1334007069","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-auth-gate","slug":"TecFancy/dsh-auth-gate","topics":["authentication","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","login","security","totp","two-factor"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Login gate for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web surface: password or shared-token sign-in, optional TO"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"TP two-factor, session cookies, rate limiting, self-service password change and a user-management CL"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"I. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 网页版登录门插件：账号密码或共享令牌登录、可选 TOTP 两步验证、会话 cookie、登录限速、自助改密，附用户管"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-auth-gate"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A login door for your DeepSeek Harness
(dsh) web instance. Put it in front of a public dsh deploymen"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"t and nobody can
reach your agents, your chat sessions, or your LLM credentials without signing
in f"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" nobody can
reach your agents, your chat sessions, or your LLM credentials without signing
in first."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Maintained until dsh ships authentication natively.** dsh has no built-in login
> yet, and this "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"repository is how we close that gap: new dsh releases are tracked
> (mount-point changes, supported "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"version ranges, Linux/Windows CI), regressions are
> fixed, and releases keep shipping. When officia"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"l authentication lands we will publish
> the migration path and keep supporting the dsh versions sti"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ll in use, so nobody is left
> on an abandoned fork."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Everything needs a login.** Every page, API call, and WebSocket connection
is checked. Visitors "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"without a valid session are sent to a simple login page
(or rejected with `401` for API/script reque"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"sts). The one exception is
`GET /manifest.webmanifest`: browsers fetch the Web App Manifest without
"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"credentials, so that exact path is public (name / icons / display mode only).
- **Two ways to sign i"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"n** (pick one in the configuration):
- **Password** (recommended): each admin gets a username and pa"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ssword.
- **Token**: one shared secret token for the whole instance.
- **Works for browsers and scri"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"pts.** Browsers use the login page; scripts and
curl can pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and sk"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ip the page entirely.
- **Admin tools.** In password mode an administrator can list users and reset "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"another user's
password, either from the **Account security** section of the Settings panel or over "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"HTTP
(`GET /auth/users`, `POST /auth/users/password`); a reset revokes that user's sessions and
forc"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"es a new password at their next sign-in before they can reach anything else. Only an
administrator o"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"n a full session sees the panel block, and the admin plane refuses to reset your
own account (use th"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"e self-service form above it, or the CLI when you have forgotten your
password).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Node ≥ 22.19 and pnpm on the server.
- dsh `0.1.x`, `0.2.x` and every later line (declared as `eng"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ines.dsh: ^0.1.0-rc.6 ||
^0.1.5-rc.2 || ^0.1.7-alpha.1 || >=0.2.0-rc.1`). The three caret alternativ"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"es record the
host lines that were verified; the `>=0.2.0-rc.1` floor keeps every host from the curr"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ent
`next` line onwards compatible, including future `0.3.x` and `1.x`. A declaration that lags
a ne"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"w host line costs more than it protects, because an incompatible bundle is skipped and
the login gat"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"e then disappears silently. Runtime-verified against `0.1.5-rc.2` and `0.1.7-rc.2` (production, in t"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"hat
order), plus `0.1.7-alpha.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.2-rc.1` (isolated instances);
the full test "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"suite runs on the `0.2.2-rc.1` host packages, and the integration
suite exercises their `resource` r"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"outes (the `/plugins` prefix and the SPA fallback)
against the real webserver. The `0.1.6-*`
prerele"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ases are not enumerated because no plugin version was verified against
them (stable `0.1.6` is cover"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ed by `^0.1.5-rc.2`). The plugin runs on the
host's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain` and `@deep"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"seek-ai/cordis`
copies — both are peer dependencies, never bundled — so a profile booted from
the ds"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"h base bundle already provides them. dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` (already on the `next` line) refuses to instal"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"l, and at boot silently
skips, plugins whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges do not cover the runnin"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"g host
version; that check reads peers only - `engines.dsh` is not consulted - and a plugin
declarin"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"g no such peer is not checked at all. The floor is therefore declared in
**both** `engines.dsh` and "},{"id":"p9s17","text":"the storage-domain peer (D28).
- The dsh `web` profile running (`dsh --profile web`).
- If `cookieSe"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"cure` is `true`, your site must be served over https (browsers
refuse secure cookies on plain http)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Notes & limitations"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The short list; the full version, including the mechanisms and the ADRs behind them,
is in `docs/dep"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"loyed/known-limitations.md`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Disabling a user only stops **new** logins; sessions already issued are revoked by the
periodic sw"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"eep (`revokeSweepMs`, 5 s by default - with `0` they stay valid until they
expire).
- Login rate lim"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"iting and the TOTP replay guard reset when the server restarts.
- Behind a reverse proxy, set `clien"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"tIpHeader` (and `trustedProxyCidrs`): otherwise all
clients share one lockout bucket, and login plus"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" the self-service change each have their
own, so both are affected.
- A password change reports succ"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ess even if revoking the old sessions fails; the failure is
logged at error level and the old cookie"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" stays valid until its session TTL.
- The `Origin` check covers the two authenticated state-changing"},{"id":"p12s8","text":" POSTs only: `POST /auth/login`
keeps `SameSite=Lax` as its only cross-site defence, and a reset who"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"se session revocation
fails still answers `200` with `sessionsRevoked:false` (plus an error log), so"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" a stale cookie
can survive until the session TTL expires.
- A reset never touches the target's TOTP"},{"id":"p12s11","text":" secret, and resetting a disabled account does not let
it sign in (the login path rejects disabled u"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"sers), so run `dsh-auth user enable <name>` first.
- An administrator without TOTP makes the admin e"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"ndpoints single-factor; enable TOTP for
administrators in production.
- The first-run wizard is a on"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"e-time window: its bootstrap session lasts at most one hour,
can only reach `/auth/*`, and closes as"},{"id":"p12s15","text":" soon as a token or a user exists. Removing that
token (or the last user) and restarting dsh opens i"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"t again.
- The wizard assumes a single dsh process, because each process mints its own launch token;"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"
behind several replicas without sticky routing the request can land on a process that does
not know"},{"id":"p12s18","text":" the token and falls back to the login page. A credentials service that caches
values may need a res"},{"id":"p12s19","text":"tart before the token saved in the wizard becomes the only credential,
and dsh versions without `con"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"nection.authenticatedUrl` have no wizard at all.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
